har0: The findings on risk of death are observational; that is, people who did short bursts of activity had a lower risk, but it has not been proven that this is entirely due to the movement. On the other hand, small experimental studies have also shown that stair snacks improve fitness and that breaking up sitting with short walks has a positive effect on blood pressure and blood sugar. In a 2025 meta-analysis pooling 11 randomised trials in inactive adults, short bouts of exercise of up to 5 minutes, done at least twice a day, improved fitness over 4–12 weeks, and 83% of participants kept up the programme. There was no clear effect on blood pressure, blood fats or body composition.
